summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-operating premium sturgeon caviar and fine wine supplier listed on Nasdaq under TWG, furnished a Form 6-K dated September 23, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a positive profit alert. The company expects net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 to rise no less than 100% year over year, driven by wine inventory sales, marketing gains and operating leverage. No transaction, stake, price or advisor is stated; the filing is a routine earnings pre-announcement, not a special situation. Watch audited results and caviar vertical-integration execution.
